description: This file implements a Git package installer for a larger software project, including functions for parsing Git URLs, cloning repositories with optimizations, validating package structure, parsing metadata, and updating installation registry with Git source info.

classes.name: GitPackageInfo
classes.description: Represents parsed information from a Git URL, including URL, reference (branch/tag/commit), and clone URL.

classes.name: GitInstaller
classes.description: Handles installation of Git packages, including cloning repositories, validating structure, and updating registry.

methods.name: newSpinner
methods.description: Creates a new spinner object with a message.

methods.name: IsGitURL
methods.description: Checks if a string is a Git URL.

methods.name: isHTTPSGitURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is an HTTPS Git URL.

methods.name: ParseGitURL
methods.description: Parses a Git URL into its components, extracting URL and reference.

methods.name: checkGitAvailable
methods.description: Verifies if Git is installed and available in the system PATH.

methods.name: InstallFromGit
methods.description: Main function to install a package from a Git repository, including cloning, validation, metadata parsing, and registry update.

methods.name: cloneRepository
methods.description: Clones a Git repository with shallow clone and optional branch/tag checkout.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory containing 'agentfield-package.yaml' and 'main.py'.

methods.name: updateRegistryWithGit
methods.description: Updates the installation registry with Git source information for the installed package.
